series.summary: A submarine flashback materializes Mr. Beauregard, unleashing a cascade of false memories that floods the house with alien parasites and corrupts Rick's own mind.

cuts.voiceover_text: A wild submarine flashback pits the family against a mystical Nazi commander, until their loyal butler, Mr. Beauregard, heroically intervenes and swears never to retire.
The planted memory becomes reality as Beauregard appears in their living room. Jerry's instant nostalgia unleashes an avalanche of flashbacks, summoning Photography Raptor.
The room is suddenly swarming with bizarre parasites. Rick frantically points to his number six on the wall, but Beauregard claims Rick was confused from the start.
A flashback exposes Rick happily counting ten friends with Pencilvestyr. Rick is terrified to realize the parasites have rewritten his own mind. Can anyone survive?
